bullets: Coil morning rule (skip coil longs when the 30-min checkpoint is DOWN): ex-market t 1.05, negative before costs, loses on up days - fails.
All-family morning map (378,411 afternoon trades, 46 family-sides): same sign in train and validation in 19 of 37 - a coin flip.
Owner's rolling-compass question will be answered as an FYI with numbers in tonight's PR.
New tool: backtest-overfitting check (PBO) - tells whether picking the best config is informative, printed beside results and controls.
Day 2 turns back to the north star: use predictable move SIZE (volume, range) without needing direction.
